description: Generates a video clip from text or a start frame at up to 1080p (Hailuo 02).

duration.description: The length of the output video in seconds.

seed.description: The random seed used for creating the noise.

dispatch_mode.description: Dispatch mode. "sync" (default) blocks until the job completes. "async" submits the job and returns immediately with a job ID; poll completion via `job_get`. Named `dispatch_mode` (not bare `mode`) so it never collides with provider-specific `mode` knobs (freepik DynamicCombo, pixverse motion mode, meshy pose mode, …).

prompt_optimizer.description: Optimize prompt to improve generation quality when needed.

prompt_text.description: Text prompt to guide the video generation.

resolution.description: The dimensions of the video display. 1080p is 1920x1080, 768p is 1366x768.
